title: Tennis Star Jannik Sinner Takes a Break to Heal His Knee
summary:
Jannik Sinner is the number one men's tennis player in the world. But he will not play again in 2026. The 25-year-old from Italy has a hurt right knee.

Sinner has not played since July, when he won Wimbledon for the second year in a row. In an Instagram video, he said he and his doctors decided his knee needs treatment. He said he "needed to think about my long-term career."

Sinner still had a great year. He won 44 singles matches and lost only three. He won six titles on hard, clay and grass courts. He also beat his rival, Carlos Alcaraz, to become number one.

Now Alexander Zverev, who is ranked second, will likely become number one by the end of the year. Zverev won the French Open and the US Open this year.
why_it_matters: Sinner shows that taking time to heal an injury is important, even for the best athletes.
